text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — PR #8427 is ready but I'm gating on architecture review. I attached a short RFC + canary plan here: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfc/8427-routing-shim. Please skim for SLO tradeoffs.

Alex: Thanks — I'll take a look today. Can you add a one-paragraph SLO delta and the proposed canary window (start/end + traffic %)?

Priya: Yep, added a short SLO delta and a 24h canary with 10% traffic. Also noted the perf numbers from staging run.

Sam: FWIW staging perf shows ~3% p50 increase vs main after batching tweak. CI green though. Might be related to KV cache warmup.

Priya: Good catch — I'll add the staging perf sketch and a warmup step to the plan.

Alex: If arch is OK with the canary + rollback criteria I'm fine with gating merge on the RFC being linked and the canary plan recorded in the PR description.

Ravi: Please include explicit rollback triggers: latency p50/p95 > 10% relative or error rate > 0.5% for 10m. Also add alert names to hook into runbook.

Priya: Added rollback triggers and alert names (INF-serve-latency, INF-serve-err). Ping @Alex @Ravi for 30m review today if you have bandwidth.

deploy-bot: Label added: arch-gated

Alex: Quick note — if we need a shorter rollout (e.g., 2h at 5%) to reduce blast radius, call it out in the RFC and we'll adjust. Otherwise I'll aim to review before EOD.

Priya: Thanks — left the option in the RFC. Appreciate the quick eyes :thumbsup:
